title: IMO-MSW cross-border message (wire export/import shape)
description: Wire shape for MSW-to-MSW exchange of IMO FAL 1-7 + MDOH content mapped to the IMO Compendium Reference Model (FAL.5/Circ.45). Normative companion of docs/imo-wco-conformance.md and mappings/msw/v1/*.yaml. Fail closed: unknown mandatory elements, unmapped fields and unregistered extensions reject the message.

sender.description: MSW operator identifier (e.g. MSW operator code of the sending window).

source.description: Export provenance: the accepted platform declaration version this message was transformed from. Absent on IMPORT-direction messages (the importing platform stamps its own provenance).

imoMessage.description: IMO Compendium Reference Model structured content. Keys are the aggregate segments of the mapped imoPath values (e.g. IMOCompendium/GeneralDeclaration/Ship/IMONumber renders as imoMessage.IMOCompendium.GeneralDeclaration.Ship.IMONumber). Content rules are enforced against mappings/msw/v1/<form>.yaml, not by this schema alone.

extensions.description: Registered platform-only fields only (mappings/msw/v1/extension-registry.yaml). Any other key rejects the message.
